Cleanup Ledger: Enbridge pipeline valve site in Hansen Township closes out with continuing obligations
what: Enbridge Energy's Jackson Road valve site closed Sept. 23 with a continuing obligation attached.
pitch: A pipeline company's contamination case at 6053 Jackson Rd closes, but the continuing obligation means something stays in the ground. Enbridge is a name readers know — worth explaining what's left behind and who's responsible.

name: Property transactions: $795,000 for buildings-only on a Town of Norrie road
what: 149 new Marathon County sales recorded, including a $795,000 Norrie single-family sale listed at zero acres.
pitch: A near-$800K price on a 'buildings/improvements only' record with 0.0 acres is unusual enough to be either a big rural estate or a data quirk. Either answer is a short story.

name: Coming Soon: two Stewart Avenue addresses still sending signals months after first permit
what: New arrivals on Sept. 23 refreshed pending signals at 2510 and 4611 Stewart Ave, Wausau.
pitch: A restaurant alteration permit at 2510 Stewart from July and an alcohol license extension at 4611 Stewart from June both got fresh activity. Two Stewart Ave openings in the pipeline — readers always want to know what's going in.

name: Gavel: County Board and Environmental Resources Committee both set for Nov. 24
what: Sixteen new meetings posted, including a Wausau Citizen Advisory Committee meeting Sept. 30.
pitch: Wednesday's Citizen Advisory Committee is the only near-term item and is worth staffing. The Nov. 24 Environmental Resources Committee is a natural place to raise the Enbridge closure once the BRRTS file is in hand.

name: Watch Ledger: 28 new ALPR cameras added, all in the Kenosha area
what: 28 camera records arrived, with sampled entries in Kenosha County, including one operated by Lowe's.
pitch: No Marathon County hook in the sample, so this is background not a story yet. But a private retailer listed as camera operator alongside Flock Safety is a thread worth pulling if the same pattern reaches Wausau.
